description: This code defines a pipeline behavior for MediatR in an ASP.NET Core application. It manages database transactions around request handling, beginning a transaction before processing, committing if successful, and rolling back on exceptions.

classes.name: DBContextTransactionPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>
classes.description: Implements a MediatR pipeline behavior to automatically handle database transactions for each request.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the request within a database transaction, committing if successful and rolling back if an exception occurs.
